name: AeroLedger
tagline: Audit-ready aerial inspections for the owner-operator.
positioning: AeroLedger turns drone flights into signed, timestamped inspection records SMB contractors can hand straight to insurers, clients, and code officials.

hero.h1: Every flight becomes a defensible inspection record.
hero.sub: AeroLedger captures your drone footage, geotags each finding, and compiles a signed PDF report your clients and insurers accept — before you land the aircraft.

features.title: Chain-of-custody reports
features.description: Each roof, tower, or facade capture is timestamped, geotagged, and locked into an audit trail no claims adjuster can dispute.

features.title: Fly-to-report in minutes
features.description: Upload from the field and AeroLedger assembles a branded inspection dossier — annotations, measurements, and cover page included.

features.title: Findings that hold up
features.description: Flag cracks, corrosion, and moisture intrusion against a standardized severity scale your whole crew applies the same way.

features.title: Client-ready delivery
features.description: Send a secure link or PDF that property owners, GCs, and carriers open without an account or a login wall.

features.title: Airspace on record
features.description: Attach LAANC authorizations and flight logs to every job so compliance questions answer themselves.

features.title: One library, every asset
features.description: Search past inspections by address, date, or defect type to quote repeat work and prove condition over time.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose a full day assembling roof reports in a spreadsheet. AeroLedger hands the adjuster a signed dossier the same afternoon we fly. Our claims approval rate went up, not our headcount.
testimonials.name: Marcus Devlin

testimonials.quote: The chain-of-custody trail settled two disputes before they became lawsuits. For a three-person shop, that's the difference between a good year and a bad one.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: I bought two seats, put my nephew on the second, and we doubled the tower jobs we can turn around each week. The reports look like they came from a firm ten times our size.
testimonials.name: Trent Kowalczyk
